prompts.prompt: We are about to test the dynamic prompt queue for FlightPath, for now, just say hello!

Look in the sample-code directory. For each file in sample-code add an additional prompt to this file (manual-test/dynamic-queue-basic-example.flightpath.json) that instruct copilot to summarize just that single file.

Summarize the contents of the single file: sample-code/example.py. Provide a short, focused summary that describes what the file does, its key functions/classes, and any notable behavior or usage notes. Do NOT include summaries of other files.

Summarize the contents of the single file: sample-code/example.ts. Provide a short, focused summary that describes what the file does, its key functions/classes, and any notable behavior or usage notes. Do NOT include summaries of other files.

Summarize the contents of the single file: sample-code/README.md. Provide a short, focused summary that describes what the file contains and any example usage or important notes. Do NOT include summaries of other files.
